Lemma
[$d(\exp _p)_0=\mathrm{id}$ along rays]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-expmap-ray ↗ lem:dc-ch3-2-5-velocity

1. ch3:2.9For every $v\in T_pM$, read in the chart at $p$, the curve $t\mapsto \exp _p(t\, v)$ is differentiable at $t=0$ with derivative $v$: \[ d(\exp _p)_0(v)=\frac{d}{dt}\big(\exp _p(tv)\big)\Big|_{t=0} =\frac{d}{dt}\big(\gamma (t,p,v)\big)\Big|_{t=0}=v. \] Together with smooth dependence on initial conditions and the inverse function theorem, this derivative identity gives the local regularity and local invertibility of $\exp _p$ near $0$.
Proof

\sketch

By subsection 1.2, $\exp _p(t\, v)=\gamma (t,p,v)$ for $t$ in the maximal interval, hence for all $t$ near $0$; by subsection 1.1 the geodesic $\gamma (\cdot ,p,v)$ has velocity $v$ at $0$.

□
